Yes — I'm happy for you to start building what we've settled. This all feels solid, and I've watched each piece behave the way I wanted, so go ahead and begin.

Before you treat this list as *everything*, though, let me flag a few things that are closely tied to what we've already built and that I haven't actually seen yet. Not asking you to stop — just want to know they're in your thinking, because to me they're part of "managing" bookmarks, not extras:

- **Putting the list in an order I choose.** We just talked about big collections loading in batches, but I never got to say how they're sorted. I'd want to flip between, say, newest first and oldest, or sort by title alphabetically — whatever makes sense for what I'm looking for at the moment.
- **Doing something to several bookmarks at once.** So far every action — tagging, read-later, setting aside, deleting — I've done one bookmark at a time. Once I've got a big pile, I'd want to select a bunch of them (or everything currently matching my search or tag) and, say, tag them all or set them all aside in one go, instead of clicking through them one by one.
- **A couple of smarter search moves.** The word-and-tag search is great, but sometimes I'd want to search for an *exact phrase* in quotes, or say "this but not that" — combine words with something like "and," "or," "not" to narrow in. Just more precise finding when the simple search casts too wide a net.

Could you tell me whether those fit into the scope you're about to build? If they do, wonderful — carry on. If you'd rather handle some of them as a later round, that's okay too, I just don't want them quietly dropped. This isn't me withholding approval to begin — go ahead and start.
